ruleSummary: Summit only for stations within 1 mi and 500 ft of catalog elevation at that summit (pinned: KMWN, A4090, A3672, MMNV1 in Mansfield pack). Nearby higher peaks use kind nearby-higher. Valley/base stations must not sit far above the place; ASOS/AWOS and RAWS preferred over CWOP. Station elevation uses USGS EPQS when NWS metadata differs by >200 ft. Bindings require a weather field (not river-only) in the last 24 h.
